subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should owner/human handoff be implemented first as a default-off WhatsApp-owned feature, designed as a shared cross-channel contract, or deferred?
rationale: The missing behavior is visible in current source, but the repair adds channel config, per-thread pause state, resume semantics, and compatibility-sensitive defaults that automation should not choose without maintainer product direction.

options.title: Default-off WhatsApp handoff first
options.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp plugin policy for manual outgoing fromMe DMs, per-conversation pause state, explicit resume/cooldown semantics, tests, docs, and live WhatsApp proof without changing existing defaults.

options.title: Design shared channel contract
options.body: Define common human-takeover semantics across message channels before implementation, accepting a broader API and config design pass.

options.title: Defer this feature
options.body: Keep current manual controls and instruction-level workarounds if maintainers do not want another auto-reply policy surface right now.

recommendation.title: Default-off WhatsApp handoff first
recommendation.body: Add a narrow WhatsApp plugin policy for manual outgoing fromMe DMs, per-conversation pause state, explicit resume/cooldown semantics, tests, docs, and live WhatsApp proof without changing existing defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr has the strongest recent ownership signal on WhatsApp inbound policy, account defaults, schema, and self-chat behavior, which are central to the recommended narrow implementation.
